Summary

We are looking for an experienced Python / web scraping developer to take over an existing real estate scraping pipeline and fix the remaining production issues.

This is not a project from scratch. The existing system already includes:

Python scraper
PostgreSQL database
FastAPI
Docker setup
Redis / worker processes
Playwright support
Proxy integration
Admin dashboard / monitoring
Data normalization and API endpoints
Existing source code and documentation

The current source is Pincali.com, a Mexico real estate website.

Main Goal

The scraper works, but it is not processing the remaining backlog reliably because of anti-bot / CAPTCHA responses and retry/requeue issues.

We need someone to review the existing codebase, identify the remaining problem, and stabilize the production scraping flow.

Main Items to Fix / Verify
Review the current proxy integration and scraper behavior
Improve handling of Pincali anti-bot / CAPTCHA responses
Verify the retry and requeue flow for failed URLs
Ensure failed URLs are actually reprocessed instead of remaining permanently stuck
Review Redis queues and worker behavior
Verify Playwright/browser fallback is working correctly
Ensure invalid/error pages are rejected and never stored as valid listings
Confirm proxy rotation, cooldown, retry, and failover logic
Improve scraping reliability and successful processing rate
Confirm that new and existing listings are being processed and updated correctly
Review dashboard / scraper-run metrics so successful and failed activity is clear
Provide updated source code and documentation for any changes made

At the last production review, the system had a large number of failed URLs waiting to be reprocessed, while Pincali was intermittently returning CAPTCHA / anti-bot responses.

The goal of this job is to get the existing system into a state where the backlog can be processed reliably and we can clearly verify successful production scraping.

Deliverable

We would consider the project complete when:

failed URLs can be successfully requeued and processed
the scraper is actively processing listings in production
proxy usage is working reliably
anti-bot / invalid pages are handled correctly
successful scrape activity can be verified through logs / dashboard
updated source code and documentation are delivered
Existing Stack
Python
FastAPI
PostgreSQL
Redis
Playwright
Docker
Rotating proxies

Experience taking over and debugging another developer's scraping code is important.

Potential Future Phase

If this project goes well, there is potential for additional work on the same system.

Our next planned phase is an AI-powered real estate assistant that would use this property database for:

natural-language property searches
property recommendations
conversational real estate search
standalone AI assistant interface
embeddable chatbot/widget for our websites
lead capture and user search tracking
future agent recommendations / routing

Strong AI / LLM experience is a plus, but the priority for this job is solving the current scraper and data pipeline issues.

When Applying

Please briefly explain:

your experience with Python scraping pipelines
your experience with Playwright and anti-bot / proxy systems
whether you have taken over and fixed existing scraper code before
how you would approach diagnosing the current retry / CAPTCHA problem
whether you would be comfortable working within the existing codebase rather than rebuilding it
